definitions.ask: Should `+` after `@file^id` also switch to `@file+id`, though `@file^id+` is the project-note form?
definitions.why: You asked for both forms, and Undo already restores the literal key for the `:`/`^` toggle

choices.label: Both forms switch; typing a project note (`@file^id+`) then takes one Undo after the swap
Only `@file:id+` switches; `@file^id+` stays the project-note form and `+` types through

definitions.ask: Should `:` or `^` typed after `@file+id` also switch it to `@file:id` or `@file^id`?
definitions.why: Only `+` was requested; `@file+id:`/`@file+id^` are invalid today, so adding it later is safe

choices.label: `:`/`^` after `@file+id` switch back too, so all three separator keys toggle freely
`@file+id` stays one-way; a stray `+` is undone with Undo
